items.title: 68189_Al Hall oral history interview
items.q: I got married again and had three kids, Barbara, Alfred and Nancy.

ctx.x: No, no. No, but she knew everybody in show business when they used to come to the theaters in Philly, you know, and by the same token I got a chance to meet them.

Then that lasted a few years, And I guess I outgrew her or she outgrew me, one or the other; but meanwhile I'm doing different things musically, and I got married again and had three kids, Barbara, Alfred and Nancy.
What was your first wife's name?
